Messages.Author: Ville Sarvijärvi
Messages.Body:
Rotschreck [Jyhad]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Play when a minion attempts to use aggravated damaged
against a vampire, whether successfully or not. Combat ends before damage is
resolved. That vampire is put in torpor, tapped, with this card on it.
During the vampire's next untap phase, burn this card instead of untapping
the vampire.

What if the vampire with Rötschreck Untapped during next untap phase ("burn
this card instead of untapping the vampire")? So, does the Rötschreck remain
on the vampire forever or something or does it burn during next untap phase?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Ville Sarvijärvi" <zar...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> What if the vampire with Rötschreck Untapped during next untap phase
> ("burn this card instead of untapping the vampire")? So, does the
> Rötschreck remain on the vampire forever or something or does it burn
> during next untap phase?

He can't untap as normal at the start of his next untap phase. If
he gets untapped by some mechanism (Movement of the Slow Body or
Alexandra's special ability, for instance), then that's fine.
Rötschreck will still be burned as normal at the start of the
untap phase (when all the vampire's controller's cards are
untapped).

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <92pr3m$qab$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

take...@my-deja.com wrote:
> If I have a minion with an Ivory Bow and I intercept another minion,
> can I play Rotschkreck before any combat cards are played?

No.
You must attempt to strike with the aggravated damage.
If the opposing minion is able to play a Drawing Out the Beast,
that will prevent you from using your Ivory Bow, and he will
have no aggravated damage to worry about, and you will not
be able to play Rotschreck.

See the ruling quoted here:
"Rotschreck is played when the attempt to use aggravated damage is
announced. If the attempt is in the form of a strike, Rotschreck is
played during the strike announcement phase (before any damage
prevention can be played). It can be played after the other strike is
announced, however. [LSJ 19990217]"

Carpe Noctem.

> If I play wolf claws and the oppsing minion plays dodge or S:CE I can
> still play Rötschreck and send him to Torpor right??????

Yes, if you've chosen "hand strike" as your strike and the
range is close (and have a strength of 1 or more - dealing 0
aggravated damage won't qualify).

> > aggravated damage won't qualify).
>
> And will he go to torpor before the damage is resolved??
> So if the opposing minion strikes, it doesn't damage my minion?

Yes.

The opposing minion, usually the acting minion in a Rotschreck
situation, will get to declare their strike, but neither strike
will resolve, because Rotschreck ends the combat once an attempt
to use aggravated damage is made.

Carpe Noctem.

strike. A strike that doesn't occur won't do any damage.
